inputs.text: Minimal flat vector app icon logo: a rounded triangular capital letter A drawn with one confident thick stroke, small sharp fox ears breaking the silhouette at the top apex, a solid play triangle sitting in the counter of the A. Flat indigo fill with a soft pink gradient glow on the right edge only. White rounded-square tile background with margin. Crisp clean edges, professional logo design, no text, no words, no photo, no shadows
